ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Nawrocki stretches and works out alongside the former champion during the meeting. A lifelong combat sports enthusiast, Nawrocki is visiting the Philippines and took the opportunity to meet one of the country's best-known athletes. Pacquiao was appointed head of the National Anti-Poverty Commission last month, moving into a new role in public service. He has compared tackling poverty to boxing, saying both require discipline, resilience and determination. The training provided a lighter moment during the Polish president's visit.
